trial_title: A Study of Ejaculatory Dysfunction in Men With Low Testosterone Levels
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to see if testosterone solution 2% can impact symptoms of ejaculatory dysfunction in men with low testosterone.

eligibility_table.criterion: Total testosterone level <10.4 nanomoles per liter (nmol/L) [300 nanograms per deciliter (ng/dL)] at screening
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's serum testosterone level of 65 ng/dL is below the threshold of 300 ng/dL (10.4 nmol/L), meeting the inclusion criterion.

eligibility_table.criterion: Presents with 1 or more of the following symptom(s) of ejaculatory dysfunction: delayed ejaculation, anejaculation, decreased force of ejaculation, or decreased ejaculatory volume, as determined by investigator assessment
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has delayed puberty and hypogonadism, but there is no specific mention of ejaculatory dysfunction symptoms, making it unclear if this criterion is met.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient reported experiencing delayed ejaculation, anejaculation, decreased force of ejaculation, or decreased ejaculatory volume during sexual activity?

eligibility_table.criterion: Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) <4 nanograms per milliliter (ng/mL) at screening
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's PSA level is not provided, but as there is no indication of prostate issues, it is reasonable to assume it is below 4 ng/mL.

eligibility_table.criterion: Sexual partner who is or becomes pregnant at any time during the study
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is male and has no reported sexual partner, making it uncertain if this exclusion applies.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient's sexual partner become pregnant at any time during the study period?

eligibility_table.criterion: Premature ejaculation as determined by investigator assessment
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about premature ejaculation, so it is unclear if this criterion is met.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been assessed by the investigator and determined to have a score indicating premature ejaculation according to the defined assessment criteria?

eligibility_table.criterion: Currently receiving testosterone replacement therapy or have a history of insufficient response to testosterone replacement therapy for ejaculatory dysfunction symptoms
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not currently receiving testosterone replacement therapy and has no history of insufficient response to such therapy.

eligibility_table.criterion: Currently receiving treatment with cancer chemotherapy or antiandrogens
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication that the patient is receiving cancer chemotherapy or antiandrogens.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of use of estrogenizing agents
eligibility_table.justification: There is no history of use of estrogenizing agents reported for this patient.
There is no current use of warfarin indicated in the patient's profile.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) and/or serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI) treatment in the 6 months prior to screening
eligibility_table.justification: There is no history of SSRI or SNRI treatment in the past 6 months as per the patient's profile.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of frequent opioid use within 30 days prior to screening, with exception of treatment for chronic pain as determined by investigator.
eligibility_table.justification: No information provided about opioid use, so unable to assess.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient used opioids for any reason in the 30 days prior to screening, excluding treatment for chronic pain as determined by the investigator?

eligibility_table.criterion: Body Mass Index (BMI) >35 kilograms per square meter (kg/m^2) at screening
eligibility_table.justification: BMI not provided; unable to determine eligibility.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's Body Mass Index (BMI) greater than 35 kilograms per square meter (kg/m^2) at screening?

eligibility_table.criterion: Significant peripheral neuropathy affecting erectile, ejaculatory, or orgasmic function
eligibility_table.justification: No information on peripheral neuropathy provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented diagnosis of significant peripheral neuropathy as defined by a neuropathy score of ≥3 on the Toronto Clinical Neuropathy Score?

eligibility_table.justification: Hematocrit level not provided; unable to assess.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's hematocrit level ≥50% at screening?

eligibility_table.criterion: Exhibit systolic blood pressure >170 millimeters of mercury (mm Hg) or <90 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure >100 mm Hg or <50 mm Hg at screening (if stress is suspected, retest under basal conditions at screening), or have history of malignant hypertension
eligibility_table.justification: Blood pressure values not provided; unable to determine eligibility.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's systolic blood pressure ≥170 mm Hg or ≤90 mm Hg, or diastolic blood pressure ≥100 mm Hg or ≤50 mm Hg at screening?

eligibility_table.criterion: History of any of the following coronary conditions within 90 days of screening: myocardial infarction, coronary artery bypass graft surgery, percutaneous coronary intervention (for example, angioplasty or stent placement)
eligibility_table.justification: No history of coronary conditions provided; unable to assess.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced a myocardial infarction, coronary artery bypass graft surgery, or percutaneous coronary intervention within the last 90 days?

eligibility_table.criterion: Known or suspected carcinoma (or history of carcinoma) of the prostate or suspicious nodules on digital rectal exam at screening
eligibility_table.justification: No information on prostate cancer or suspicious nodules provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a history of prostate carcinoma or any suspicious nodules detected on digital rectal exam?

eligibility_table.criterion: Known or suspected breast cancer (or history of breast cancer) or other active cancer (with the exception of nonmelanotic skin cancer)
eligibility_table.justification: No information on breast cancer or other active cancers provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a current diagnosis of breast cancer or any other active cancer, excluding nonmelanotic skin cancer?
